text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I approach the front gate of
the
academy, I catch a glimpse of
someone rushing
into a taxi and
speeding away.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Hey, you! Have you seen a reporter pass by?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
choice_data_list: タクシーに乗って行った
choice_data_list_en: She got in a taxi and left.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That reporter was here to photograph
our
training, but the fool used the flash!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I explicitly forbade its usage before we
started.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. I'll call the publisher later and file
a
complaint.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After chasing down that reporter, Air
Groove
looks a bit worn out.
